item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We are unequivocal: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade of its creation. Its power will transform how humanity produces and distributes life’s essentials.

2. If we build superintelligent AI within 20 years, extreme poverty will disappear worldwide within the following decade. Abundant energy, better medicine, plentiful food, affordable housing and universal education will become achievable at unprecedented speed.

3. We expect nothing less than the worldwide end of extreme poverty within a decade of superintelligent AI being built. If it arrives in the next 20 years, it will give us the intelligence and capacity to overcome scarcity and meet every person’s basic needs.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

Our position is unequivocal: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade of its creation. We expect intelligence at that scale to accelerate scientific discovery, expand abundant clean energy, transform food production and housing, and make high-quality health care and education universally accessible. It will give societies the tools to overcome scarcity, build effective public systems and direct resources wherever they are needed. The result will not be a modest reduction in deprivation. It will be the end of extreme poverty in every country and community. We are preparing now to help ensure that extraordinary progress reaches everyone.
